title: EE60041: Large Scale Systems
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction: Time and frequency-domain modelling and representation of large
scale system (LSS). Hierarchical control of LSS. Decentralised control of LSS.
Near-optimum design. Case studies. Stabilization of LSS using Linear Matrix
Inequality (LMI) approach.
Model reduction problem. Aggregation method, Perturbation methods (weakly
coupled models, strongly coupled models). Balanced realisation-based model
order reduction. Hankel based methods. Frequency domain methods for model order
reduction-Pade
Routh, continued-fraction expansion and mixed methods for SISO
and MIMO systems. Low order controller design methods.
